title: Evening of clairvoyance set to return to town by popular demand
excerpt: An evening of clairvoyance is returning to Bewdley by popular demand next month.
content:
Clairvoyance evening in Bewdley to raise charity funds

Barbara Northall (Image: Supplied)

This article is brought to you by our exclusive subscriber partnership with our sister title USA Today, and has been written by our American colleagues. It does not necessarily reflect the view of The Herald.

An evening of clairvoyance, raising vital funds for cancer research, is returning to Bewdley by popular demand next month.

Well-known medium Barbara Northall, promises messages of hope, laughter and inspiration, during the event at Wharton Park Golf and Country Club on Tuesday, November 17.

Organised by the Wyre Forest Committee of Cancer Research UK, guests will also be able to browse stalls and take the opportunity for private psychic readings with Barbara.

Committee chair Anita Rose said: “This will be the third evening of clairvoyance we have hosted with Barbara and we are very grateful for her support.

“We are anticipating another sell-out event as she is incredibly popular, with an international reputation.

“Having lost her own mother to cancer, she knows the pain of loss and the need for research funding to advance treatments and cures.

The bar will be open and food can be ordered from 6.30pm by contacting Wharton Park on 01299 405222.

Tickets for the event, starting at 7.30pm, are £20 and are available online at Eventbrite or by calling 07766 313430.
